title: Price, cost and supplier by code
objective: Return three different columns of the product list for each order line, using the same key.
instructions: For each order line, use the product code in column B as the key and the product list in G1:K6 as the source. In column C return the retail price, in column D the cost and in column E the supplier. Lookup and return ranges must have the same number of cells. Fix the ranges with $ signs.
hints: Start with C2: =XLOOKUP(what to find, where to look, what to return). The code to find is in B2.
The code column in the product list is G2:G6. The retail price column is I2:I6, the cost column is J2:J6 and the supplier column is K2:K6.
Use $ signs on the list ranges, for example $G$2:$G$6 and $I$2:$I$6. The lookup range is the same in all three columns, only the return range changes.
Case does not matter: sd-120 finds SD-120. The text result in column E is the supplier name exactly as written in the list.
